findings.title: Kinship tightens into an oppositional band

findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for fatherhood, kinship, attachment, binding, and a supporting band meet the independent 12:5 carriers for plotting, enmity, and rebellious opposition; the contact reties intimacy around a grievance and makes the collective self-description socially operative.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence becomes more than a report of jealousy: the favored dyad and the speaking group appear as two formations competing around one paternal center.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains the brothers' complaint about unequal love and their own strength. The rival-band image is a local pericope resonance supplied by the reviewed channel and 12:5, and it does not claim that every kinship use has this hostility.

epistemic.reason: The channel review is trusted and the focus/context surfaces are exact; the three context-only source-image branches are retained with their supplied image statements rather than expanded into independent lexicon claims.
